defect: r3 treatment flags stripped from the LEASED CHILD environment
mechanism: run_cell builds the child env from grm_c2_cells.environment(flags), which deletes every ambient GRM_* name. spawn_env re-applied only the arm pin and the admission rule, so F1/F2/F5 never crossed the process boundary.
severity: a treatment arm would EXECUTE AS THE CONTROL while its receipts recorded the flags as on -- silently wrong, not failed
